tasks.title: Add animation to calculator title
tasks.description: Add CSS animation to the 'Mini Calculator' h1 title in src/App.tsx (line 31). Create a smooth fade-in and slide-down animation in src/App.css using @keyframes. Apply the animation to the h1 element with appropriate duration (0.6-0.8s) and easing (ease-out). The animation should trigger once on page load and be subtle and professional.
acceptance_criteria: Title animates smoothly on page load with fade-in and slide-down effect
Animation uses appropriate easing function for natural motion
No layout shift or janky behavior during animation
